children.title: codejunkie99/agentic-stack

children.title: SenolIsci/mykg

children.title: expo-llm-wiki (equationalapplications)

children.title: smgam29/knowhub
children.description: A Python library that compiles technical documents into cross-confirmed knowledge graphs, exporting to JSON, Neo4j, or OKF.

children.title: JeanBaissari/llm-wiki-monorepo
children.description: (PyPI) - A production-grade monorepo combining a Python CLI, MCP server, and graph engine for self-building Markdown wikis.

children.title: llm-wiki (krishddd)
children.description: (PyPI) - A self-healing agentic knowledge engine and FastAPI service implementing the Google Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.1 specification. Distributes ingested documents across four memory tiers (working, episodic, semantic, procedural), executing automated bi-temporal fact tracking, Ebbinghaus memory decay, NLI-based contradiction resolution, and a staged "Review Autopilot" to verify low-confidence drafts.

children.title: DeepWiki-Open (Grok-Wiki)

Uses autonomous agent pipelines to cross-reference unrelated metadata timelines into highly detailed, interlinked markdown pages complete with standard Wikipedia-style information sidebars, event logs, and relationship networks.

children.title: BYO-LLM-WIKI (Lyra-stellAI)
children.description: (Live Demo) - A local-first Flask web application, JSON API, and CLI utility that implements the Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern using deepagents. children.title: Wikiwise

children.title: Myco (cmblir)
children.description: A personal knowledge base tool that compiles unstructured files (PDFs, docs, images, media) into an organized Obsidian-compatible wiki vault. children.title: jp-lorenc1o/Eva-brain
children.description: (Website) - A local-first macOS desktop client and MCP server for building and browsing personal markdown knowledge vaults.

children.title: yologdev/yopedia

children.title: talirezun/the-curator

children.title: WikiMind (Manav Gupta)

children.title: Silica (kiycoh)
children.description: (GitHub) - A local-first transactional agent and web GUI workbench for Karpathy-style LLM Wikis and Google's Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2). children.title: Memento

Converts unstructured documents into an interlinked, Wikipedia-style knowledge base featuring a 2D physics-based interactive knowledge graph, a stateful LangGraph ingestion pipeline, LangSmith validation, a zero-hallucination grounded QA assistant with click-through citations, and cross-device Turso Cloud database connectivity.

Enables agents to ingest multi-format sources (PDFs, URLs, YouTube videos, Markdown), automatically generate cross-referenced wiki nodes, and maintain persistent memory across separate chat sessions.

children.description: A Python-based CLI utility, background daemon, and MCP server that compiles web resources, PDFs, and YouTube transcripts into Obsidian-compatible markdown vaults. Exposes a unified MCP tool (wiki) to support hybrid DuckDB-backed search, automated cross-link sweeping, claim verification audits, and topic cluster synthesis.

children.title: Linkly AI

children.description: (crates.io) - A headless, git-backed wiki engine written in Rust that exposes 23 MCP tools and streaming ACP support for agents and IDEs. Features JSON-Schema-validated frontmatter, Tantivy full-text indexing, typed knowledge graph generation (Mermaid/DOT), and zero internal LLM dependencies.

children.title: PieKBS
children.description: (Docs) - A local-first knowledge search engine for agents that distills raw documents into structured Markdown wikis via LLM. Features FTS5 full-text search, graph-based document expansion via citation/support/wiki links, multi-hop tag expansion, and native MCP server integration. Pure Go binary with no external dependencies.

children.title: mcp-llm-wiki (np6126)
children.description: (GitHub) - A Git-backed HTTP Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing an isolated tool surface for Karpathy-style LLM Wikis. Features 8 atomic tool primitives, ETag optimistic concurrency with custom merge-drivers for index and log contention, Markdown sanitization, containerized isolation, four companion agent skills, and operator CLIs (wiki-init, wiki-clip).

children.title: Hindsight
children.description: (GitHub / Obsidian Plugin) - An open-source, model-agnostic agent memory system designed to help agents learn and adapt over time rather than just recalling raw logs. It organizes memory into facts, observations, and user-curated mental models, exposing simple retain/recall/reflect APIs alongside an optional LLM wrapper and self-hosted Docker interface.

children.title: Basic Memory
children.description: (GitHub) - A cloud-hosted (SaaS) or local-first (AGPL-3.0) persistent memory platform and MCP server. Syncs Obsidian-compatible Markdown files across web, mobile, and IDEs, utilizing SQLite/Neon PostgreSQL and Milvus backends to provide hybrid semantic search, cross-encoder reranking, and official plugins for Claude Code, Hermes, and OpenClaw.

children.title: Stash
